question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Dogmatic
solution:
The correct answer is: **Flexible**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"dogmatic"** refers to someone who is assertive about their opinions or beliefs, often to the point of being rigid or inflexible. It typically implies an unwillingness to consider other viewpoints. (कट्टर / हठी)

 
 
• **Example:** The professor's dogmatic approach to teaching left little room for discussion or differing perspectives.
 
 

 
• **"Flexible"** refers to someone or something that is adaptable and open to change or different ideas. It is the opposite of being rigid or dogmatic. (लचीला)

 
 
• **Example:** A flexible teacher welcomes diverse opinions and encourages constructive debates in the classroom.
 
 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'dogmatic'** is **'flexible'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Flexible**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Stubborn** (जिद्दी): Refers to someone who is unyielding or unwilling to change their opinions or actions.

 
 
• **Example:** He is too stubborn to admit when he’s wrong.
 
 

 
• **Rigid** (कठोर): Refers to being inflexible or unable to adapt to changes or new ideas.

 
 
• **Example:** Her rigid stance on the issue made it difficult to reach a compromise.
 
 

 
• **Arrogant** (अहंकारी): Refers to someone who has an inflated sense of self-importance or superiority.

 
 
• **Example:** His arrogant tone alienated many of his colleagues.
